message.content:
Yes – you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Atlanta’s noise‑related issues are handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** and the **City Hall Code‑Enforcement Office**. Below are the main ways to submit a complaint: | Method | How to File | Contact | |--------|-------------|---------| | **Online (311)** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal and select “Noise Complaint.” You’ll be prompted to fill out a short form with details about the location, time, and nature of the disturbance. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | | **Phone (Non‑Emergency)** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **404‑292‑2000** and request to file a noise complaint. They will either take the information over the phone or direct you to the appropriate unit. | 404‑292‑2000 | | **In‑Person** | Go to City Hall (1400 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303) and speak with a Code‑Enforcement Officer. Bring any documentation (e.g., dates, times, photos, or audio recordings) that supports your claim. | City Hall – 1400 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | | **Mail** | Send a written complaint to:
City of Atlanta, Code Enforcement Division, 1400 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303. Include your name, address, phone number, and a detailed description of the noise issue. | 1400 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | ### What the City’s Noise Ordinance Covers - **Title 10, Chapter 2 – Noise Ordinance** (Atlanta Municipal Code). - Prohibits excessive noise during certain hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.) and sets decibel limits for residential and commercial areas. - Violations can result in citations, fines, or other enforcement actions. ### Tips for Filing a Successful Complaint 1. **Document the Incident** – Record the exact dates, times, and duration of the noise. If possible, capture audio or video evidence. 2. **Identify the Source** – Provide the address or intersection where the noise originates. 3. **Describe the Impact** – Explain how the noise affects you or your neighbors (e.g., sleep disruption, health concerns). 4. **Follow Up** – After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy for any follow‑up inquiries. ### Quick Links - **Atlanta Police Department**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/police - **City of Atlanta 311 Portal**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 - **Noise Ordinance (PDF)**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/sites/default/files/2024-01/Noise%20Ordinance.pdf Feel free to use any of the above methods to report the noise issue. The city’s enforcement teams are equipped to investigate and address complaints promptly.
